downloadIntro.zh: Windows 版已更新至 v1.58.0，Mac 版当前为 v1.57.55。请选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: Windows is now v1.58.0; the current Mac release is v1.57.55. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: 支持 Pine Script：v5/v6 直接运行，v1–v4 的旧写法会自动转换。指标脚本粘贴到「指标」区，策略脚本粘贴到「回测」区。支持标签、线段、方框、表格和渐变填充，支持读取同品种其他周期的数据、import 自己保存的 Pine 库。脚本设置按 TradingView 的方式排布，有分组、同行、勾选框、颜色和提示说明。报错提示是中文，脚本运行出错时，图例上会标出出错的行。脚本列表会标明语言：Pine、通达信或 JS。
highlights.en: Pine Script support: v5/v6 scripts run as they are, and older v1–v4 syntax is converted automatically. Paste indicator scripts in Indicators and strategy scripts in Backtest. Labels, lines, boxes, tables and gradient fills are drawn, and scripts can read other timeframes of the same symbol and import Pine libraries you have saved. Script settings are laid out as on TradingView, with groups, inline rows, checkboxes, colours and tooltips. Error messages appear in the app's language, and a script that fails while running marks the failing line in its legend. Script lists show each script's language: Pine, TDX or JS.

highlights.zh: Pine 策略回测：在「回测」区可以和通达信策略一样回测，结果存成回测存档。手数、手续费、隔夜利息和强平都按软件里的账户规则算；K 线内谁先成交，可以选按 1 分钟 K 线或 Tick 来推算。
highlights.en: Pine strategy backtests: backtest Pine strategies in Backtest just like TDX strategies and save the results as backtest sessions. Position size, commissions, swap and stop-outs follow the app's account rules, and fills inside a bar can be worked out from 1-minute bars or ticks.

highlights.zh: 图表窗格可以拖到其他显示器：按住窗格标题栏的空白处拖出主窗口，松手的那块屏幕上就会打开一个图表窗口，拖回主窗口就还原。所有窗口共用回放进度、账户和画线，合计最多 18 个窗格（每个窗口 9 个），下次启动时窗口回到原来的位置。另外新增 3+2、4+3、4×2 三种布局。
highlights.en: Move chart panes to another monitor: drag a pane by the empty part of its header out of the main window, and a chart window opens on the screen where you let go; drag it back to return it. All windows share the replay position, account and drawings, with up to 18 panes in total (9 per window), and the windows reopen where you left them. New 3+2, 4+3 and 4×2 layouts.

highlights.zh: 复盘地图的交易列表旁新增「损益」页，显示累计盈亏曲线，以及每笔交易的最大浮盈和最大浮亏。鼠标悬停可以看这笔的明细，点击就在图上定位到这笔交易。
highlights.en: A P&L tab beside the replay map's trade list shows the cumulative P&L curve and each trade's run-up and drawdown. Hover a trade for its details, or click it to find it on the chart.

highlights.zh: MACD 新增「样式」和「柱子数值」两项设置。样式可选 TradingView（默认）或经典；柱子数值可选 2×(DIF−DEA)（默认，和文华、通达信一致）或 DIF−DEA。已有的 MACD 会换成新样式，但自己改过的颜色会保留；想要原来的样子，选「经典」即可。
highlights.en: MACD gains Style and Histogram value settings. Style is TradingView (the default) or Classic; the histogram value is 2×(DIF−DEA) (the default, as in Wenhua and TDX) or DIF−DEA. Existing MACDs switch to the new style but keep any colours you changed; choose Classic for the old look.

highlights.zh: 图表外观向 TradingView 看齐：网格改成实线，时间刻度更密，网格和时间刻度一直延伸到最后一根 K 线右侧的空白处。日、周、月分隔线改成蓝色短虚线，画在两个周期之间、K 线下方，不再压住 K 线。
highlights.en: Charts look more like TradingView: solid grid lines, denser time labels, and grid lines and time labels that continue into the empty space right of the last bar. Day, week and month separators are short blue dashes drawn between periods and under the candles, so they no longer cover them.

highlights.zh: 画图属性栏可以直接改矩形、圆形等形状的填充颜色和透明度。模板菜单可以另存模板，也能直接套用已保存的模板。左侧画图栏的删除按钮：图上只有画线或只有指标时直接清除，两种都有时先问清除哪一种。
highlights.en: Change the fill colour and opacity of rectangles, circles and other shapes right from the drawing properties bar. Its template menu can save a new template and apply saved ones directly. The bin on the drawing toolbar clears drawings or indicators straight away when the chart has only one kind, and asks which when it has both.

highlights.zh: 开多个窗格时，十字光标所在的价格会同时显示在其他窗格的价格轴上；多个窗格同时回放和画线时也更流畅。
highlights.en: With several panes open, the crosshair price also shows on the other panes' price axes, and replaying and drawing across many panes is smoother.

highlights.zh: 「图表显示」菜单新增「时间线（交易时段 / 自定义时刻）」开关。
highlights.en: A Time lines (sessions / your moments) switch in the Chart display menu.

highlights.zh: 修复指标副图重启后的几处问题：拖动调整过的高度、「保存为自定义」之后的零轴线不再丢失，隐藏的 MACD 柱子不会再冒出来；在指标设置里双击复选框，也不会再把窗格放大。
highlights.en: Fixed indicator subplots after a restart: resized subplot heights and the zero line of an indicator saved with Save as custom are kept, and a hidden MACD histogram stays hidden. Double-clicking a checkbox in indicator settings no longer maximises the pane.
